claim.text: The preregistration ledger is an unbroken signed log, and signed-head.json signs all of it.

control.description: Change one field of ledger entry 3; its body no longer matches its digest.

covers: Chain links, entry digests, the Merkle root, the signed head's size and root, and consistency proofs from the frozen size-1 head.
does_not_cover: Who holds the key: the key is read from FREEZE.json in the same directory unless --public-key-hex is given from elsewhere. Entries the author never added (publication completeness).
